scope: Public startup-history V2 CPU/GPU World and minimap composition, first16 map2/zero-items queues. Paced motion coverage and separate unpaced diagnostic costs; no gameplay frame-rate claim.

native.gpu_policy: Owned native CPU composition mirrored to retained GPU surfaces at completion

profile.scope: Debug diagnostic consumer; GPU submission is host time, readback includes deferred GPU work. Queue wall time includes producer/timer waits; excludes original simulation and pre-entry work. Checkpoints include GPU mirror, readback, serialization, hashing and disk writes. CPU reference remains enabled; proof FIFO blocking is not a frame benchmark.
